build_sampler_from_config: build a sampler from config using build_sampler with dataset and other_args parameters
register_custom_sampler: register a custom sampler class with the register_sampler decorator using a unique name
create_distributed_sampler: create a DistributedSampler instance for shuffling dataset across multiple GPU replicas
create_repeat_factor_sampler: create a RepeatFactorDistributedSampler that oversamples rare categories using repeat factors from annotation frequency
create_infinite_distributed_sampler: create an InfiniteDistributedSampler that yields indices indefinitely for training with max_update instead of max_epoch
